decision.observation: The red-sand ramp ends against a dark rock mass; at left a sloped mottled orange-dark rock dome rises toward the ridge crest, where a pale pillar ruin stands, and the lone palm sits at the crest center. The palm trunk is at the right edge, and stamina is full green.
decision.hypothesis: The mottled dome at left has a gentle slope and may be walkable up to the ridge top near the pillar ruin. Sprinting forward-left onto it should test whether it climbs.
decision.memory: Sloped mottled dome left of the dark rock may be a walkable ramp to the ridge crest.
